request.style: English, male baritone solo with gospel choir, acoustic guitar, piano, organ, cymbals, warm and solemn, 75 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
In the fourth year of King Jehoiakim
The word of the Lord came to Jeremiah
He called for Baruch son of Neriah
To write the words of the Lord on a scroll

[Chorus]
As Jeremiah dictated the words of the Lord
Baruch wrote them down with faithful hands
Through the fire and the fear of the king
The scribe remained by the prophet's side

[Verse]
In the house of the Lord at the New Gate
Baruch read the words in the hearing of all
But the king cut the scroll with a knife
And threw the words into the fire

[Chorus]
As Jeremiah dictated the words of the Lord
Baruch wrote them down with faithful hands
Through the fire and the fear of the king
The scribe remained by the prophet's side

[Bridge]
You are seeking great things for yourself
Do not seek them for I will bring disaster
But wherever you go I will grant
Your life as spoil in the whole land

[Outro]
They went to the land of Egypt
Not obeying the voice of the Lord
